additions.text: A whole night in a 3D airport: real Spanish for travelling, complaining and negotiating.
A hearse? How scary! Well, yes.
A man in a cap wants to go in. Gisela works in the VIP lounge.
Bruno is looking for a suitcase. Hortensia works here.
Calm down, madam. I am stopping the belt.
Calm down. There is another flight at six.
Captain Arturo eats empanadas. Marisol cooks.
Cheeses. Twelve cheeses for my grandchildren.
Dayana is a nurse. Esteban lives at the airport.
Delfina and her brother Bruno look at the screen.
Do you give your seat to other people?
Do you have a big family?
Do you have brothers or sisters?
Do you have nieces or nephews?
Do you prefer the train or the plane?
Do you prefer window or aisle?
Do you travel alone or with your family?
Do you use the internet every day?
Do you wait a lot in lines?
Don Teodoro talks to Yesenia. He travels with his wife's urn.
Doña Inés waits in the line. She talks to Gerardo.
Father, I am scared. It is my first flight.
For Valeria. She is my internet girlfriend.
Gustavo wants to get on the plane. Débora works at gate 12.
Hello, Doña Inés. How are you?
Hello. I am looking for a blue suitcase.
Here you are. A window, please.
Hi, Vanesa. I am at the airport.
Hmm… Very well. That is one hundred dollars.
Horacio buys perfume. Vanesa works in the shop.
How many days has she been waiting?
How many empanadas does he order?
How many grandchildren does she have?
How many hours do you sleep?
How much does Fabián give her?
How much money does she have?
I am a nurse. I am tired. I want to sleep.
I am going to ask the passengers.
I am going to be a grandfather.
I am sorry, sir. The flight is full.
I am sorry. Those are the rules.
I do not have one. I am Tito Ventura.
I have one car. It is black and big.
In Lima? When does it arrive?
It is a liquid. It cannot go through.
It is dulce de leche. For my niece.
It is okay. Here you are.
It is three dollars, with the fee.
It is you! Come in, come in.
Kiara needs a car. Cristian rents cars.
Madam, what is in the suitcase?
Mónica and Iván work on the plane. They talk on the terrace.
Mónica, the six o'clock flight is full.
Nayeli changes coins. Fabián works here.
No, three. Tomorrow is my last flight.
No. For my wife. She likes the clouds.
Oh, no! The dress is inside.
One moment. It is in Lima.
Osvaldo talks to Doña Carmela. She is carrying a lot of cheese.
Please. My daughter is having a baby today.
Ramiro is a taxi driver. He calls his wife, Vanesa.
Raquel is afraid of flying. She talks to Hugo.
Rocío's suitcase is open. Wilmer helps.
Thank you, Marisol. Your empanadas are the best.
Thank you! It is very pretty.
The singer? It is not possible!
Think about Luna. Everything is going to be fine.
Three? That is very little! No, thank you.
Tired. Three days in the line.
Ulises buys flowers. Leonor sells flowers.
What a problem! One person is not travelling today.
What car color do you like?
What color are your clothes today?
What color do you like for flowers?
What do you buy at the airport?
What do you buy with twelve dollars?
What do you eat at night?
What do you think of Horacio?
What does Rocío say at the end?
What is Gustavo going to be?
What kind of car is it?
What time is the other flight?
Where does he know Valeria from?
Who is the second perfume for?
Yes, it is raining a lot.
Yes. I am bringing empanadas for breakfast.
Yes. One for my wife and one for a friend.
A liquid? No! It’s my grandmother’s.
A lot of people are sleeping here. Esteban has a blanket and a plant. Dayana is a nurse. She is very tired.
And a seat for a guitar?
Are there queues at your supermarket?
Are there taxis in your city?
Are you sad or happy today?
Arturo looks at you: “Are you scared?”
At customs there is a lady with twelve cheeses and a parrot. Osvaldo works here.
Bruno has an old, ugly dress.
Bruno looks at you: “What do I do?”
But there are seats on the plane. They don’t use the car.
Calm down. There is another flight.
Can the dress come on the six o’clock plane?
Dayana looks at you. What do you do?
Delfina looks at you: “What do I do?”
Do you have a boyfriend or girlfriend?
Do you have a photo of your granddaughter?
Do you have a special card?
Do you have a special friend?
Do you have brothers or sisters?
Do you have nephews or nieces?
Do you have photos on your phone?
Do you sing in the shower?
Doña Inés gives you a kiss.
Esteban, please. I want to sleep!
Fabián works at the currency exchange. Nayeli has a backpack and a lot of coins.
Gerardo gives you a place very quickly.
Gerardo looks at you: “Do you want a place?”
Here, in the urn. Her name is Amparo.
Hi. I don’t have my sister’s dress.
Hi. This is the airport. It’s ninety dollars.
How many cousins do you have?
How much is twelve plus three?
I have twelve dollars. I’m hungry.
I want two seats: one for me and one for my wife.
I’ll sing! Everybody looks at me.
I’m going to see my granddaughter.
I’m Tito Ventura. I’m a singer.
It is night. It is raining a lot. You are in a taxi. The taxi driver is Ramiro.
It’s a quarter to six. It isn’t raining any more. Débora is at gate twelve.
It’s a small chapel. There are candles. Raquel is scared. Hugo is the chaplain.
It’s my fifth empanada. I’m nervous.
It’s my first flight. I’m scared.
It’s raining today. With rain, the price is double.
It’s three in the morning. Arturo is a pilot. He is eating empanadas. Marisol is the cook.
Iván’s name comes out. Everybody gets on!
Kiara wants a car. Cristian works here. There is one key.
Leonor looks at you: “What do you say?”
Lucrecia looks at Matías’s backpack. There is a jar of dulce de leche.
Lucrecia, can you keep the jar?
Matías looks at you: “What do I do?”
Mónica looks at you: “What do you do?”
Nayeli looks at you. What do you say?
Nayeli, I’ll pay for the food.
No. Twelve cheeses is a lot.
On the six o’clock plane there isn’t a seat for everybody.
One for my wife. One for a friend.
Osvaldo looks at you: “Does she go through or not?”
Ramiro is angry. So are you.
Ramiro is very happy. He sings in the rain.
Ramiro looks at you: “Are you paying?”
Raquel looks at you: “And you? Are you scared?”
Rocío is red. But she laughs.
The plane is safe, my child.
There are three places. Only three.
There is a big screen. Your flight is AB 2317. It says: CANCELLED. Delfina is very sad.
There is a lot of smoke in this room. Mónica is a flight attendant. Iván talks a lot.
There is a very long queue. Gerardo works here. Doña Inés is sitting down. She is making a scarf.
There is another flight at six.
There is one. It’s black and big. It’s for funerals.
There’s a problem. One seat is missing.
There’s a seat! It’s 14C. It’s for you.
This is the duty-free shop. Vanesa sells perfumes. Horacio is buying two identical perfumes.
This is the lost luggage office. Hortensia works here. Bruno comes in.
This is the VIP lounge. Gisela is at the door. A young man is wearing sunglasses. It is night.
Those are my clothes! Don’t look!
Tito goes in. He is happy.
Tito looks at you: “Will you help me?”
Ulises has a coffee with Leonor.
Ulises has flowers and a sign: “Welcome, Valeria”. Leonor sells flowers.
Ulises, there are no more passengers.
Valeria arrives today. She’s my girlfriend!
Vanesa and you laugh a lot.
Vanesa looks at you: “What do you think?”
Very good! Have a good trip.
What colour are your clothes today?
What do you eat at night?
What time do you go to sleep?
Wilmer, can you stop the belt?
Yes, she goes through. They’re for her family.
Yes… I want to go home.
Yesenia looks at you: “What do I say?”
Yesenia works here. Don Teodoro is an old man. He has a blue urn.
You are in Arrivals. There is an open suitcase on the belt. Rocío’s clothes go round and round.
You eat with Nayeli. She is very nice.
You pay fifty. Ramiro gives you a broken umbrella.
…No, Mum… the flight is at six… put the bread on the table… zzz… Who are you?
A dog is arriving today from another country. It is for me. Its name is Tango. I do not know it, but I already love it very much.
Are you good at speaking in public?
Boyfriend trying to talk his girlfriend out of flying
Businessman closing a deal on the phone
Do you fall asleep in strange places?
Do you get angry a lot or a little?
Do you have a driving licence?
Do you have a favourite teacher?
Do you have pets at home?
Do you like dancing? What do you dance?
Do you like the sea or the mountains?
Do you read the newspaper on paper or on your phone?
Do you sometimes work at night?
Do you talk in your sleep?
Do you use your phone a lot?
Economist reading a newspaper from three days ago
Girl doing her homework in the queue
Grandfather eating the most expensive soup of his life
Grandmother narrating the cancellation live to her family
Grandmother who has been waiting for a suitcase since 2009
Huh? What? I am awake. I am working. I am waiting for Mr Ortega. My sign is… upside down? Oh!
I am a teacher. Well, I was a teacher. I read the airport signs. There are a lot of mistakes! I have a red pen.
I am a writer. I am writing a novel. Tonight there are a lot of stories here. It is perfect for my book!
I am doing my maths homework. My mum is in the queue. I am sleepy. What is seven times eight?
I am eating a soup. It costs twenty dollars. Twenty! At home, a soup costs two. But I am hungry.
I am eighty. I have never seen the sea. My wife always wanted to go. Now I am going, for her.
I am fifteen. I am travelling alone. My mum does not know yet, but my suitcase is lost. I am a bit nervous.
I am reading a book. It is called “Learn to Wait”. I am on page two. I am waiting for my girlfriend. She is late.
I am reading the newspaper. It is from Monday. The news is old, but it is interesting. There is no new newspaper today.
I am talking to my girlfriend. She is travelling to another country to work. I do not want her to. I am going to miss her a lot.
I am talking to my grandchildren on my phone. I tell them everything: the rain, the queue, the angry man. It is like a film!
I am the barman. I make drinks for famous people. Today there is a singer hiding in the toilet. Shhh!
I am very tired. I sleep standing up. It is easy: I close my eyes and… What? No, I am not sleeping!
I am waiting for my suitcase. It is green and has flowers. It is coming from Madrid. I have been waiting for many years. I come every Thursday.
I am working on the phone. I am talking to a client in Japan. It is daytime there. It is night here. I am very tired!
I want a car, but I do not have a driving licence. Is that a problem? Cristian says yes. I do not understand why.
I want to speak to the boss! To the boss’s boss! I pay a lot of money. And there is no flight. It is unbelievable!
Influencer sleeping with a luxury eye mask
Man crying because he is going to miss a dance contest
Man demanding to speak to the owner of Aerobruma
Man who talks to his suitcase on the phone
Mother waiting for her son after five years
Musician sleeping with his arms around his guitar
My first perfume! It is vanilla. It is very expensive, but it is my money. I work on Saturdays in an ice-cream shop.
My guitar travels with me. It does not go in the suitcase. I sleep with it. It is my best friend.
My son lives in Australia. I have not seen him for five years. He arrives today. My sign says: “Welcome home, Nico”.
My suitcase has a phone inside. I am calling it now. It is ringing! It is close, but I cannot see it.
Retired teacher who corrects the airport signs
Shhh. I am sleeping a little. My eye mask is silk. Tomorrow I take photos on the beach. Today, photos on the floor.
Sleeping chauffeur with an upside-down sign
Student reading a self-help book to pass the wait
Teenager travelling alone for the first time
Teenager who has bought her first perfume
The customs dog is following me! I do not have anything. I only have my grandmother’s biscuits in my backpack.
Today is my day! I signed my divorce this morning. I am very happy. This glass is the third… or the fourth.
Tomorrow is my ex-husband’s wedding. I am speaking at the wedding. I am writing my speech. It is difficult, but it is nice.
Tomorrow there is a dance contest. I have danced with my wife for fifty years. No flight, no contest.
Traveller the customs dog will not leave alone
VIP lounge barman who knows every secret
